name: hyperlocal-connect
description: HyperLocal-Connect — Zero-Commission Local Marketplace connecting workers, artisans, street vendors and customers in India

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CUSTOMER,PARTNER" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:customer --prefix client" "npm run dev:partner --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:prod: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
